description.zh: 我的研究兴趣主要集中在以下几个领域：
description.en: My research interests are mainly focused on the following areas:

description.zh: 利用静态分析和动态分析方法，研究程序行为分析与理解的技术
description.en: Study of techniques for analyzing and understanding program behavior, including static and dynamic analysis methods

description.zh: 研究自主智能体及其在各个领域的应用
description.en: Exploration of autonomous agents and their applications in various domains

title.zh: 基于代码混淆的人工智能软件保护系统
title.en: AI Software Protection System Based on Code Obfuscation

detail.zh: 针对 AI 模型本地部署后，其二进制文件易被逆向工程提取模型结构与权重，导致知识产权泄露的行业痛点，开发基于混淆的代码保护系统，在不影响模型精度和性能的前提下，将逆向工程成本提升至经济不可行，使本地人工智能软件免受逆向分析等手段的攻击，保护模型开发者的知识产权。
detail.en: Designed an automated code protection based on TVM and LLVM IR to shield localized AI models from reverse engineering, preventing unauthorized extraction of proprietary model architecture.

detail2.zh: 将传统混合布林代数（MBA）从整数域突破性拓展至浮点数域，攻克了传统方法无法保护AI模型核心浮点计算的难题，提出并证明了混淆变换的正确性，确保混淆前后模型输出100%一致。
detail2.en: Pioneered the theoretical expansion of Mixed Boolean-Arithmetic (MBA) from the integer domain to the floating-point domain, successfully obfuscating core AI operations (e.g., Conv) while maintaining 100% numerical consistency.

detail3.zh: 基于 TVM 机器学习编译器和 LLVM 编译器架构，在 LLVM IR 中间表示层设计并实现了自动化混淆 Pass ，支持用户自定义混淆参数，生成可直接部署的混淆版二进制库/可执行文件，实现了性能开销与安全强度的灵活平衡。
detail3.en: Engineered a custom LLVM Pass to implement multi-level obfuscation during TVM compilation, allowing for tunable parameters such as recursion depth and MBA complexity to balance performance overhead and security strength.

detail4.zh: 浮点数表达式和 AI 模型运算结果在混淆前后100%一致，反混淆工具成功率下降30%以上，逆向工程成功率下降40%以上，同时提出统一的混淆效果量化指标体系，衡量代码混淆的强度和安全性。
detail4.en: Quantified efficacy by developing a standardized metric system; experimental results showed a >30% decrease in de-obfuscation success rates and a >40% decrease in reverse engineering success rates compared to SOTA works.

detail5.zh: 作为共同第一作者和项目负责人完成论文。
detail5.en: Authored a research paper detailing the implementation.

title.zh: 基于向量数据库和人工智能的智能漏洞分析系统
title.en: AI-Powered Vulnerability Analysis System Based on Vector Databases

detail.zh: 采用双模数据库架构，结合关系型数据库 MySQL 和向量数据库 Chroma 的优势，实现结构化数据管理和语义相似性检索的完美结合。
detail.en: Architected a hybrid vulnerability detection system utilizing Chroma (Vector DB) and MySQL (Relational DB).

detail2.zh: 结合程序切片技术，使用 Tree-Sitter 解析不同程序语言，对抽象语法树（AST）进行程序切片，提取程序中的数据流和控制流依赖关系。
detail2.en: Implemented program slicing and static analysis to parse ASTs and extract data-flow/control-flow dependencies.

detail3.zh: 利用 CodeT5+ 模型捕捉程序深层语义，利用 GraphCodeBERT 模型捕捉程序结构，生成含语义与结构双重特征的切片向量，识别潜在漏洞。
detail3.en: Developed a semantic-structural embedding engine utilizing CodeT5+ and GraphCodeBERT to export vectors of program slices.

detail4.zh: 构建自然语言接口，用户输入查询需求，系统通过云端 LLM API 自动生成 SQL 查询语句，实现对关系型数据库的智能查询。
detail4.en: Engineered a natural language interface that automates SQL query generation via cloud-based LLM APIs.

title.zh: 基于Linux内核模块的包过滤防火墙

detail.zh: 基于 Linux Netfilter 框架，设计并实现一个内核级包过滤防火墙，旨在为内部网络提供接近线速的实时流量控制与基础入侵防护。
detail.en: Designed and implemented a kernel-level firewall leveraging the Netfilter framework to intercept and analyze network traffic at key hooks.

detail2.zh: 开发 Linux 内核模块，实现有状态过滤和基于协议的访问控制。
detail2.en: Developed a Linux Kernel Module to enforce stateful filtering and protocol-based access control.

detail3.zh: 通过 Netlink 套接字和字符设备设计跨层通信系统，实现安全事件同步和规则更新。
detail3.en: Architected a cross-layer communication system using Netlink sockets and character devices to synchronize security events and update rules.

detail4.zh: 开发了提供类 iptables 语法的命令行工具，支持图形化界面直观展示实时流量、拦截日志与报警信息，提升系统易用性。
detail4.en: Built a management suite including a CLI tool with iptables-like syntax and a GUI dashboard for anomaly visualization.

title.zh: 新型电力系统分布式协调控制器设计
title.en: Design of a New Distributed Power Coordinated Controller

detail.zh: 设计一套去中心化的“云-边”协同控制架构，应对新型电力系统中海量分布式资源与电/气/热多能流耦合带来的建模与控制复杂性挑战。
detail.en: Architected a decentralized "Cloud-Edge" collaborative control framework to address modeling complexities in modern power systems.

detail2.zh: 基于图论与多智能体系统理论设计了一致性变量的更新律，保证一致性算法收敛性和功率平衡特性，提升系统稳定性与鲁棒性。
detail2.en: Developed a distributed consensus algorithm based on Multi-Agent Systems and Graph Theory, featuring global convergence and power balancing.

detail3.zh: 基于遗传算法，以通信拓扑网络的连接矩阵为染色体，筛选出抗延时能力最强、可靠性最强的上层网络拓扑结构，提高网络性能。
detail3.en: Optimized communication network reliability by implementing a Genetic Algorithm (GA) to evolve adjacency matrices.

detail4.zh: 使用树莓派开发基于 TCP 协议的通信网络，实现上层云平台、下层微电网控制器的分布式架构。
detail4.en: Implemented the distributed architecture on Raspberry Pi hardware using TCP/IP protocols for real-time data exchange.

originalTitle.zh: 英文原题：Protecting Floating-Point Computation for DNN Binaries with MBA Obfuscation

description.zh: 我的学术论文与预印本

title.zh: 利用 MBA 混淆保护深度神经网络二进制程序中的浮点计算
title.en: Protecting Floating-Point Computation for DNN Binaries with MBA Obfuscation

description2.zh: Yikun Hu, Zichen Zhao, Peixiang Qin, Ziyi Zhou, Jiaping Gui, Yuandao Cai, Wensheng Tang
description2.en: Yikun Hu, Zichen Zhao, Peixiang Qin, Ziyi Zhou, Jiaping Gui, Yuandao Cai, Wensheng Tang

description3.zh: FLOB 将浮点数提升至更高精度的表示空间，再应用混合布尔算术变换，以保护编译后的深度神经网络。论文报告在保持计算正确性的同时，算子平均恢复率降至 4.51%，较现有方法低 32.82 个百分点。
description3.en: FLOB protects floating-point operations in compiled deep neural networks by lifting values to a higher-precision representation and applying mixed Boolean-arithmetic transformations. The paper reports preserved computational correctness and an average operator recovery rate of 4.51%, 32.82 percentage points lower than existing methods.
